name: Yearning: A Gay Story
source:
Yearning: A Gay Story, or YAGS, is a coming-out-focused character-driven slice-of-life visual novel with dating sim elements (phew) where you play as a gay man starting his freshman year of college at a generic university somewhere in the midwestern United States.

You will interact with a cast of characters, each with their own personality and stories, as you navigate college life, develop friendships, play board games, and come out. With luck, you might even find a boyfriend.

[From [url=http://yags.bobcgames.com/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
《向往：同性恋故事》（YAGS）是一部以出柜为中心、以角色为主导的生活片段视觉小说，带有约会模拟元素（哇），你在其中扮演一名同性恋者，在美国中西部某处的一所普通大学开始他的大学一年级。

当你度过大学生活、发展友谊、玩棋盘游戏和出柜时，你将与一群角色互动，每个角色都有自己的个性和故事。运气好的话，你甚至可能找到男朋友。

[来自[url=http://yags.bobcgames.com/]官方网站[/url]]
